title: UTMC Fault Support
description: Shared fault support types (acknowledgement state, fault type definition).

AcknowledgementState.description:
Acknowledgement state of a device fault.

Maps from legacy XSD integer values:
- 0 -> notAcknowledged
- 1 -> acknowledged
- 2 -> deferred
- 3 -> recordedForAction

FaultCategory.description:
Coarse grouping for catalogue entries.

Deliberately short. It exists so an operator can filter "show me the
communications faults" without the catalogue having to agree on a
taxonomy first; the precise meaning of a fault is its catalogue entry,
not its category.

FaultStatus.description:
Whether a fault is still active or has been cleared.

This is the only fault lifecycle the payload carries. Record archival
— distinguishing a live record from a retired one — is not modelled
here and is a matter for the publishing system.

FaultTypeDefinition.description: Catalogue entry describing one kind of fault that can be reported.

description.description: Human-readable description of the fault type.

subsystemTypeId.description: Reference to a SubsystemDefinition entry: the subsystem this fault type belongs to.
subsystemTypeId.title: TypeId

code.description: The identifier this fault carries in its source document or vendor documentation — 'A1', 'F3', 'W12'. Distinct from faultTypeId, which is this catalogue's key: a deployment may hold two entries with the same code from different vendors.

category.description: Coarse grouping, for filtering rather than semantics.

messageTemplate.description: Human-readable message with positional placeholders, e.g. 'Minimum green not met: stage {0} ran {1}s against a minimum of {2}s'. A fault instance supplies the values in its parameters field. This is what lets a catalogue carry faults whose meaning depends on runtime values — the stuck-stage and interstage timing faults that a closed enum cannot express.

parameterNames.description: Names for the positional placeholders in messageTemplate, in order — ['stageNumber', 'actualSeconds', 'minimumSeconds']. Lets a consumer label the values rather than only interpolate them. Length SHOULD match the number of placeholders.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.
